.1 mukham, vaktram, vadanam, āsyam मुखम्, वक्त्रम्, वदनम्, आस्यम्
Mouth, face

ITA-9.9.41 vakrī वक्री
Abnormallyshaped penis
Impotency due to penile deformity.

ITA-9.8.17 vāk-siddhiḥ वाक् -सिद्धिः
Eloquence
An articulate command of the language.

ITA-1.7.24 vākyadoṣaḥ वाक्यदोषः
Syntax error, defective sentence
A statement deficient in any of the five components of a sentence, thereby resulting in incomplete or distorted expression of meaning.

ITA-1.7.25 vākyapraśaṃsā वाक्यप्रशंसा
Correct statement
A statement free of any syntactical deficiencies and congruent with its exactly intended meaning.

ITA-1.6.27 vākyaśeṣaḥ वाक्यशेषः
Supply of ellipsis
A statement in which some word(s) are lacking and have to be correctly surmised and supplied to derive the exact meaning of a sentence in its given context.
